scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && node --import tsx --test tests/smoke/*.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: node --import tsx --test tests/integration/*.test.ts && npm run test:integration --workspace @bridge/integration-platform
scripts.test:e2e: node --import tsx --test tests/e2e/*.test.ts && npm run test:e2e --workspace @bridge/manager-workspace && npm run test:e2e --workspace @bridge/web-chat && npm run test:e2e --workspace @bridge/saas-admin
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:integration && npm run test:contract && npm run test:e2e
scripts.ci:quick: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:contract
